scope: one pass of each sealed height stream; 10 C rows + 6 accepted historical N rows; no live training stream read
comparison_limits: N reaches actual RR placement; C remains AIR. Different full-body trajectories/control revisions; corresponding tasks are not matched states.
World link origins/collider minima are not measured contact points. Joint angle signs do not establish physical direction or causality.
Only RR hip authored joint frame is logged; FR/FL hip world joint frames and knee pivot world frames are unavailable in these height files.
Per-tick current contacts/bearing forces are absent from the height files. Only C terminal evaluator current contacts are attached; historical N event chronology does not supply exact per-row load.
Available Cartesian downward workspace or support-triangle stability margin is not computed. Reported mount-to-wheel vertical span is current geometry, not remaining reachable travel.
